# Active playtime rewards

Build, explore and play to unlock permanent conveniences.

**Server coming soon!** This is the public launch specification. Checkout remains closed while the server and store are tested.

## Claims and force loading

Start with 64 claim chunks and 2 force-loadable chunks. Earn another 8 claim chunks per 10 active hours and 1 force-loadable chunk per 50 active hours, continuing beyond 500 hours. Your current paid-rank bonus is added once. A team's limit uses its member with the largest allowance. Force loading runs only while someone from the team is online.

Home and public-warp counts are total allowances. Use whichever is higher: your earned allowance or your paid-rank allowance. Public warps are player-owned destinations for towns, shops and builds; `/pwarp` lists them.

## Travel and combat

Everyone has `/back`. Artisan includes `/rtp nether`; Runeforged includes `/rtp end`. Random travel finds safe terrain and avoids other players' claims. Teleports use a five-second warmup and stop if you move or enter combat. Combat disables travel for 30 seconds.

Permanent `/fly` works in your team's claims and ends when you leave or enter combat. `/heal` has a 10-minute cooldown, `/feed` a five-minute cooldown, and the limited effects last five minutes with a 15-minute cooldown. Waypoint travel requires a destination you have personally visited.

## Machinery and reward kits

Functional Create machinery and Sable contraptions unlock after 30 active hours, or immediately with any paid rank. Decorative blocks remain available. Machinery may still be crafted, looted, traded, picked up or mined before unlocking. Schematicannons and banned items stay banned at every rank.

The HNN kit includes 16 Furnace Generators, 256 coal and 32 energy cables. The AE2 starter kit includes two Furnace Generators, 64 coal and 16 energy cables. Train your own HNN models. The wireless terminal kit includes network hardware and a charger; you still build and bind your network. The infinite item cell stores items supplied to it and does not generate resources.
